eyebrow: The on/off switch for internet access
code:
aws ec2 create-internet-gateway

aws ec2 attach-internet-gateway \
  --vpc-id vpc-0abc123456789def0 \
  --internet-gateway-id igw-0def456789abc123
caption: A VPC gets at most one Internet Gateway, and it does nothing until it's explicitly attached.
There's no public/private flag on a subnet — it's public purely because its route table sends 0.0.0.0/0 to the IGW.
